name: BrainWake
tagline: An alarm clock you switch off by solving vocabulary, trivia or math challenges
role: React Native app by the Softwhere team for a European edtech client

scenes.title: Each alarm can end in a challenge
scenes.body: Snooze limits are set per alarm, and going idle mid-quiz (30 s by default) makes the alarm ring again.

scenes.title: Math, trivia or vocabulary
scenes.body: Per alarm: difficulty, question count, trivia categories, and vocabulary in English or Swedish.

scenes.title: Quiz content ships offline
scenes.body: Bundled JSON banks: 2,153 trivia questions and 1,747 words in English and Swedish, plus 7,980 math problems.

scenes.title: Spaced repetition built in
scenes.body: Answer right, then pick when the word returns: 3 days to never. A summary shows time, score and level.
